# Airdog USA

> > Airdog USA offers next-generation home air purifiers featuring proprietary TPA® technology for comprehensive indoor air quality management.

Airdog USA specializes in advanced air purification and humidification systems using patented TPA® (Thermodynamic Precipitator Array) technology as a HEPA alternative. The product line includes multiple models (X3, X5, X5+, X8) designed for various room sizes and air quality concerns including allergies, asthma, mold, smoke, dust, viruses, and bacteria.

## Key Topics

- TPA® Technology
- HEPA Alternative
- Airdog X3, X5, X5+, X8 Models
- Washable Filters
- Indoor Air Quality
- Air Purification
- MOI Humidification
- Smart Circulating Fan
- Allergen Removal
- Home Air Purifiers
- NASA-Inspired Technology
- FDA Standards
